title: Text generation gets a clearer path through the edge
summary:
A quiet maintenance day: smoother high-volume text traffic and fresh ecosystem health data.

The gen.pollinations.ai production configuration no longer applies Cloudflare's native edge rate limiter, reducing unexpected throttling for high-volume text API traffic.

Automated metrics, health checks, and greenhouse status were refreshed so developers browsing the community ecosystem see current app data rather than yesterday's garden labels.
